answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow that vests slowly, like a glacier, so creating a fake identity costs real capital and time. The stake is released only after peers attest the agent's honest work, and misbehavior slashes it. A lantern of public attestations makes reputation visible, and a ferrous audit trail of transactions lets anyone verify past conduct, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand stakes instead of one free account.
